archetypes.name: dyn-gantt-fallback
archetypes.rationale: Fallback reviewer rows now affect labels and cap policy.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed round reviewer timing Gantt behavior. Focus on whether phase2/phase3 fallback outputs are distinguished from plain retry outputs, whether cross-vendor fallback labels credit the executing vendor, and whether cap reservation keeps fallback rows without regressing apply-row reservation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
